meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 它会用不断追问的访谈方式打磨你的计划或设计，并在过程中同步生成文档：ADR（架构决策记录）和术语表。访谈通过 /grilling 流程进行，并调用 /domain-modeling 技能。
howto.when: 该技能已禁用模型自动调用，需要你手动触发；在你想要打磨一份计划或设计时使用。

say.text: 用 /grilling 打磨一下我这个计划
开始 /grilling，顺便把 ADR 和术语表写出来
say.note: 访谈过程中同步产出文档

say.text: 用 /grilling 追问我的设计，配合 /domain-modeling
say.note: 访谈中会调用 domain-modeling 技能

howto.what_en: It runs a questioning interview that sharpens your plan or design, and writes docs as it goes: ADRs and a glossary. The session runs via /grilling and uses the /domain-modeling skill.
howto.when_en: Auto-invocation by the model is disabled, so you trigger it yourself; use it when you want to sharpen a plan or design.

say_en.text: Start /grilling and write the ADRs and glossary as we go
say_en.note: Docs get produced along the way
